**Amendment, 2026-09-16: the gate's machinery is total, and the phase rule reads a label.** [Issue #403](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/403) found two weaknesses in the machinery this record added. Neither is in a decision above and both are in the gate that enforces them. `bulletsUnder` sliced from `indexOf`, so a heading the file did not have made the offset `-1`, and the helper then counted bullets from an arbitrary byte offset while its failure message named a section it had never found. It also counted a bare marker and a comment-only bullet as entries, which satisfies "exactly one entry" while stating nothing a reader can check. And the phase rule read one spelling of the label: bold, capitalised, colon-terminated, so an unbolded, a lowercase, a dash-separated and a `Current phase` bullet all passed.

Three answers, and none of them moves a decision above. The section reader is line-oriented and refuses a heading it cannot find, so the arithmetic that caused the defect is deleted rather than corrected and a heading on the last line of the file is found like any other. An entry has to state something after its marker, because one entry means one statement a later slice can replace. The phase rule strips emphasis and matches the label case-insensitively in the label position only, which is deliberately narrower than matching the word: **Open, and not scheduled** says packaging follows the current phase, and prose that mentions a phase inside a real entry is not a second **Now**. The label is refused; the noun is not.

The evidence is the part worth naming, because both weaknesses were latent. The section-list case catches a missing heading before the reader can misread one, and the file is clean of every phase spelling today, so a case reading the live file cannot pin either. The cases therefore exercise the helpers directly: a missing heading, a heading at the end of the file, a section that stops at the next one, a blank bullet, a comment-only bullet, an entry with a sub-list, two entries, every spelling of the label, and one real entry whose prose mentions a phase and stays allowed.
